title: voacanga gracilipes
intro: Voacanga gracilipes, commonly known as the African voacanga tree, is a tropical plant native to West Africa, belonging to the Apocynaceae family. It has been traditionally used in medicine and has been found to have several health benefits, including its potential to improve cognitive function, boost libido, and aid in weight loss. The therapeutic actions of Voacanga gracilipes include its ability to act as a central nervous system stimulant, increasing alertness and energy, as well as its potential to act as an anxiolytic, reducing anxiety and stress. The bioactive constituents of Voacanga gracilipes include voacangine and voacorine, which are indole alkaloids that have been shown to have pharmacological properties.
